info.author: district
info.name: gm_blackout
info.description: Blackout: intercepts near-fatal damage (onPlayerDamage) and fatal damage that bypasses it entirely (onPlayerWasted - fall/drown/explosion, see BlackoutService.lua's own comment) and puts the player into a timed, controllable-but-locked-out low-health state instead of letting MTA's own death/respawn flow run. CEF full-screen overlay with a countdown (BlackoutOverlay.tsx).
